info.name: Temenos Transact Core Banking Accounts Deposits API

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of records to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: page_start
params.description: Page token or offset for pagination

params.name: maturityDateFrom
params.description: Filter deposits maturing from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: maturityDateTo
params.description: Filter deposits maturing up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

items.docs: Retrieve deposit arrangements including term deposits, savings deposits, and fixed deposits. Supports filtering by customer, maturity date range, status, and currency.

params.name: depositId
params.description: Unique identifier of the deposit arrangement

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information for a specific deposit arrangement including principal amount, interest rate, maturity date, accrued interest, and renewal options.
